title: Execution of copy gates
statement: Let $V$ be a list of Boolean values and $v_s$ a list of natural-number indices, each strictly less than the length of $V$. Executing, in order, the copy gates for the indices in $v_s$ from $V$ yields $V$ followed by the values of $V$ at those indices, in the order specified by $v_s$.
